New versions of all thirteen apps on the latest Selkies base.

## ⚡ Improved

- **Newer apps:** CADCraft 0.19.0, DeckCraft 0.17.0, DesignCraft 0.19.0, EffectCraft 0.23.0, FigCraft 0.17.0, FilmCraft 0.19.0, GridCraft 0.18.0, LightCraft 0.20.0, PdfCraft 0.20.0, PhotoCraft 0.22.0, SoundCraft 0.19.0, VectorCraft 0.23.0 and WordCraft 0.17.0. Each image still installs the official `.deb` after checking it against the release's `SHA256SUMS.txt`.
- **Updated base image:** the LinuxServer Selkies base moves to its latest build, with Ubuntu's current security updates.
